import json,hashlib,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path(".").resolve()
sha=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print("spec-state", sha("system-spec/spec-state.json"))
print("index.md", sha("system-spec/index.md"))
d=json.load(open("eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json"))
print("spec_dir",d["spec_dir"], "verdict", d["verdict"], "evaluator", d["evaluator"])
snap=d["artifact_snapshot"]
print(type(snap), json.dumps(snap,ensure_ascii=False)[:600])
items = snap if isinstance(snap,list) else snap.get("files", snap.get("artifacts", snap))
mis=0;n=0
def walk(o):
  global mis,n
  if isinstance(o,dict):
    p=o.get("path"); h=o.get("sha256") or o.get("digest")
    if p and h:
      q=pathlib.Path(p); q = q if q.is_absolute() else root/q
      if not q.exists(): q=root/"system-spec"/p
      n+=1
      a=sha(q) if q.exists() else None
      if a!=h: mis+=1; print("MISMATCH",p,h,a)
    for v in o.values(): walk(v)
  elif isinstance(o,list):
    for v in o: walk(v)
walk(snap); print("snapshot entries",n,"mismatch",mis)
'
